text_block_list.text:
One day. Entering the library, I spotted 
Win Variation deeply engrossed in a book. 
The title was...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This? Well, you know... I wanted to get 
better at turning that inner haze into 
strength. So I'm studying with this 
psychology book.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's just, there are way too many ways to 
do it, so I don't know which one's the 
best...
choice_data_list:
In that case, let's try them together and 
find a good one.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: For real? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
First, let's try regulating our autonomic 
nervous system with deep breaths-ssu. I 
heard it's effective if you picture 
something pleasant when you inhale-ssu.
choice_data_list: What comes to your mind, Shion?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess so... Like a fresh, juicy apple, 
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A vast apple orchard... Harvested apples 
piled high into baskets――...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I think I smell something delicious...! 
I'm gonna take a deep breath of this 
air...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......*deep breath*......

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the power pose. Striking a 
confident pose is supposed to actually 
boost your confidence, you know.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Like, strike a pose like this, or...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: And, a pose like this...!
choice_data_list: Then I'll do it too—— Shakiin!
Then I'll do it too—— Shakiin!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Gotta keep on posing! âHyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—...Got it. I've got a read on it. My 
resting pulse rate, that is.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It'd be ideal if I could reset back to 
this condition whenever I need to.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So, sharing the intel with you too, 
Trainer. —Here you go.

I take her outstretched hand and check Win 
Variation's pulse.
(Thump, thump, thump...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If I ever lose my cool, I want you to 
remember this rhythm so we can get back to 
it."

And then—the two of us went up to the 
deserted rooftop, looked up at the blue 
sky, and caught our breath.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna face myself through meditation! 
Trainer, are you ready?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Now then—... Focus your awareness—... on 
your breath—...

—...As I close my eyes and keep breathing, 
memories of Win Variation rush through my 
mind one after another.

The passionate emotions when I witnessed 
her running, fueled by frustration—... The 
joy when she signed the contract with 
me—...

"Facing all of those head-on makes me 
realize anew. I want to support the 
Umamusume named Win Variation to the very 
ends of the earth—..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ――...How was it, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
...Yeah. I think I was able to put things 
into perspective.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Me too. A lot of things crossed my mind 
while meditating."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The ones that came up the most were... 
memories with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Thanks to that, I got the courage 
to keep fighting.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Any emotion can be turned into power... 
That's what you taught me, and hearing 
that made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Searching for mental training methods 
together was so fun and reassuring...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I feel like I'll be fine. 
Even if dark thoughts try to drag me down 
in the future...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Lighting a burning passion in their heart, 
willing to stick with them through any 
kind of hard work—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Because I have... such a strong ally on my 
side—...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I might cause ya some trouble here and 
there, but... I'm countin' on you from now 
on. Trainer-san."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'll continue to support you from 
now on.

Yeah, I'll keep supporting you from here 
on out, too.

If there's anything you want to do, just 
let me know!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I might cause ya some trouble here and 
there, but... I'm countin' on you from now 
on. Trainer-san."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'll continue to support you from 
now on.

Yeah, I'll keep supporting you from here 
on out, too.

If there's anything you want to do, just 
let me know!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —...! Yes, ma'am!

"And then, as if to hide their 
embarrassment, the two of them looked up 
at the sky once more."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In that case, there's still another 
method I haven't tried yet—would you do it 
with me?

After that, the two of them tried out 
various types of mental training, such as 
Zazen meditation and yoga.
